status: selected among tested ideal-output candidates; not a trained predictor
time_base: same monotonic clock used by observer and controller

header.expires_s: t + 1 second freshness limit; not prediction horizon
header.horizon_s: H, configurable and identical for oracle and learned provider

windows.wss_bytes: nonnegative per-window working-set estimate in bytes; use one documented observation method
windows.occupancy_delta_bytes: signed application occupancy change at window end versus issue, excluding future reclaim by this service; negative means predicted self-release
windows.pgfault: nonnegative number of faults in this window (start_s,end_s]; never cumulative since issue

cold_supply.reclaimable_bytes: CURRENT additional resident cold supply safe through safe_until_s, not a reset of the session attempt budget
cold_supply.safe_until_s: absolute validity bound; positive supply in tested candidate is unused through the current horizon; reuse within horizon returns zero supply

not_learned_outputs: required reclaim amount and begin/finish times are computed by the controller
current free space, high/max/low/min, used budget and reclaim calibration are direct observations/configuration
fixed session high uses a separately declared reference/calibration envelope, identical across arms; the experiments do not show this envelope can be inferred from a 20-second rolling forecast
input_selection: not established by an oracle; preserve raw history for later 2/4/8/16-second ablations
scope: whole-app hot/cold synthetic clean-file donation; no trained heat classifier, page-targeted reclaim, anonymous compression or GUI latency claim
